newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums hold, but only small lots done.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums hold, but only small lots done.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums to gas oil futures were steady on Friday amid slack physical buying.
Stronger IPE gas oil helped propel jet prices higher.
Traders said second half February barge material was heard talked at March IPE +$26 a tonne fob NWE with cargoes holding around March IPE +$27-28.
"Only bits and pieces are being done, it's pretty quiet," said one.
Swaps business was also a touch muted after the recent heavy buying that has seen airlines picking up more than a million tonnes of jet on the paper market.
"The paper buying was to lock in at what are seen to be relatively weak numbers, " said one dealer who thought the market was starting to show signs of becoming balanced.
